en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard. The front shows a panoramic view of a hilly, wooded area with a winding road, scattered houses and tall trees. In the foreground are prominent stone ruins on an open plateau. At the bottom margin, Hungarian text identifies the location as part of the Mecsek hills near Pécs. The reverse side contains a handwritten Hungarian message, an address in Budapest, a printed Hungarian postage instruction box, and a circular postal cancellation mark.
